title: StreetWide world format 0.1: shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the world-format schemas. See rfcs/0001-world-format.md. Some rules (sort order, cross-references, canonical bytes) cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced by op_world.

int53.description: Integer exactly representable in IEEE 754 double precision.

contentId.description: BLAKE3-256 hash of a file's exact bytes.

tileKey.description: Web Mercator z17 tile, "z/x/y". x and y must be below 131072.

regionKey.description: Web Mercator z12 region, "z/x/y". x and y must be below 4096.

featureId.description: Namespaced id of what an asset depicts, e.g. "osm:way:123".

vec3mm.description: Position [x, y, z] in integer millimetres (X east, Y up, Z south).

boundsMm.description: Axis-aligned bounds in integer millimetres; min <= max per axis.

attribution.description: Credits to display, sorted and unique.
